Azure Government note: Dynamic RLS is Gov-ready.

This model loads security-user-territory.csv into the SecurityUserTerritory table and relates it to DimTerritory on TerritoryKey. The 'Dynamic Territory Security' role (Modeling > Manage roles) applies:

[UserPrincipalName] = USERPRINCIPALNAME()

to SecurityUserTerritory, which cascades to DimTerritory, FactSales, and FactTargets.

Sample UPNs to test with View as > Other user:
- alex.manager@contoso.example (2 territories: Mid-Atlantic, South Central)
- casey.lead@contoso.example (1 territory: Pacific Northwest)
- devon.director@contoso.example (4 territories — all of them)
- jordan.rep@contoso.example (1 territory: Mountain)

Tasks: 1) Select Modeling > View as, check 'Dynamic Territory Security', enter one sample UPN, and select OK. 2) Compare the table below for a single-territory user (casey.lead) vs. a multi-territory user (devon.director). 3) Document results for both cases. 4) Turn off View as when finished.

Expected result: the model filters territories based on the current user's mapping rows in SecurityUserTerritory.
